# Identity

**Package** `telividb.identity.v1`

## Services

### `Identity`

Manages users, groups and the role bindings that grant over the tree.

| Method | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CreateUser` | `CreateUserRequest` | `User` | Creates a user. |
| `GetUser` | `GetUserRequest` | `User` | Retrieves a single user. |
| `ListUsers` | `ListUsersRequest` | `ListUsersResponse` | Lists users. |
| `DeleteUser` | `DeleteUserRequest` | `User` | Soft-deletes a user, cascading to the memory they own. |
| `UndeleteUser` | `UndeleteUserRequest` | `User` | Restores a soft-deleted user before they expire. |
| `CreateUserGroup` | `CreateUserGroupRequest` | `UserGroup` | Creates a user group. |
| `GetUserGroup` | `GetUserGroupRequest` | `UserGroup` | Retrieves a single group. |
| `ListUserGroups` | `ListUserGroupsRequest` | `ListUserGroupsResponse` | Lists user groups. |
| `DeleteUserGroup` | `DeleteUserGroupRequest` | `UserGroup` | Soft-deletes a user group. |
| `CreateRoleBinding` | `CreateRoleBindingRequest` | `RoleBinding` | Grants a role to a group over part of the tree. |
| `GetRoleBinding` | `GetRoleBindingRequest` | `RoleBinding` | Retrieves a single role binding. |
| `ListRoleBindings` | `ListRoleBindingsRequest` | `ListRoleBindingsResponse` | Lists role bindings. |
| `DeleteRoleBinding` | `DeleteRoleBindingRequest` | `RoleBinding` | Revokes a role binding. |

### `User`

A person, and separately the principal policy evaluates against.  A user is two things at once and they are kept apart deliberately: an owner of memory, and a principal whose visibility predicate runs on every query. Collapsing them would make every permission change a user edit, and grants attach to groups rather than to people for the same reason.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the user. |
| `display_name` | `string` | 2 | `REQUIRED` | Human-readable name. |
| `principal` | `string` | 3 | `REQUIRED` | The principal identifier policy evaluates against. Distinct from the resource name so an account can be renamed without rewriting every grant that refers to it. |
| `user_groups` | `repeated string` | 4 |  | Groups this user belongs to. |
| `create_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 5 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the user was created. |
| `update_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the user was last modified. |
| `delete_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 7 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the user was soft-deleted, or unset while live. Deleting a user cascades to the memory they own. A user delete that left their memory searchable would be the worst bug available here, so the cascade is part of the operation rather than a follow-up. |
| `expire_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 8 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When a soft-deleted user is purged and becomes unrecoverable. |
| `etag` | `string` | 9 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Opaque value for optimistic concurrency on update. |

### `RoleBinding`

A role granted to a group over part of the tenancy tree.  Grants attach at an organization, project or space and inherit downward, which is what makes "the projects a principal can see" a set small enough to compile into a bitmap once per query.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the binding. |
| `user_group` | `string` | 2 |  | The group this grants to. |
| `role` | `string` | 3 | `REQUIRED` | The role granted, such as `reader`, `writer` or `owner`. |
| `scope` | `string` | 4 | `REQUIRED` | The resource this applies to — an organization, project or space. |
| `create_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 5 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the binding was created. |
| `etag` | `string` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Opaque value for optimistic concurrency on update. |
